task.title: Bring back your profile on a new phone
task.shortdesc: Your 12 recovery words bring your profile to a new phone.

taskbody.prereq: You need your recovery words. See .

step.cmd: Open and tap I already have a profile.
On Bring back your profile, type your 12 recovery words in order.
step.info: The counter shows how many words you've entered, for example 7 of 12 words.

taskbody.result: Your profile comes back. If you see Welcome back, tap Fill in my profile to finish setting it up.

postreq.note: Posts, chats, and matches stay on your old phone. They don't come back.
